title: VPN connection drops frequently
description: The corporate VPN disconnects every few minutes or loses connection repeatedly.
resolution: Check internet stability, reconnect to the corporate VPN, and verify that the approved VPN client is updated. If the issue persists, escalate to the network support team.

title: Password reset issue
description: The user cannot sign in after forgetting their password or the password reset process fails.
resolution: Use the organization's approved password-reset portal and complete identity verification. Contact the service desk if the reset fails.

title: Laptop running slowly
description: The employee's laptop performance is very slow, applications respond slowly, or the device freezes.
resolution: Restart the laptop, close unnecessary applications, and check available disk space. Contact IT support if the issue continues.

title: Office equipment issue
description: Shared office equipment such as a printer, projector, or other workplace equipment is not working.
resolution: Check the equipment's power and basic connections. Report persistent issues to the facilities or equipment support team.

title: Office access card not working
description: An employee cannot enter the office using their access card or badge.
resolution: Check whether the access card is valid and assigned to the employee. Contact the authorized facilities or security team to verify access permissions.

title: Air conditioning not working
description: The air conditioning in an office area is not functioning properly or the room temperature is uncomfortable.
resolution: Report the affected location and issue to the facilities team. Follow workplace safety guidance while the issue is investigated.

title: Request for software installation
description: A user needs approved software installed on their work laptop or workstation.
resolution: Submit a software installation change request with the application name, business justification, and device details. Obtain the required approvals before installation.

title: Request for system configuration change
description: A user needs a change to an existing IT system, application, or configuration.
resolution: Submit a change request describing the proposed configuration, business reason, impact, risk, and rollback plan. Obtain approval before implementation.

title: Request for access permission change
description: An employee needs additional or modified access to an approved application or IT resource.
resolution: Submit an access change request with the required role and business justification. Obtain manager and application-owner approval before access is modified.

title: Office layout change request
description: A team requests a change to desk layout, seating arrangements, or shared office space.
resolution: Submit a workplace change request describing the requested layout, affected area, business reason, and preferred timing. Obtain facilities and management approval before work begins.

title: Office access or badge arrangement change
description: An employee requests an approved change to physical office access, access-card assignment, or entry arrangements.
resolution: Submit a request to the authorized facilities or security team with employee details, location, requested access, and business justification. Obtain required approvals before making changes.

title: Facilities maintenance change request
description: A department requests planned maintenance or a modification to office facilities, such as lighting, air conditioning, or meeting-room equipment.
resolution: Submit a facilities change request describing the work, location, expected impact, preferred schedule, and safety considerations. Obtain facilities approval before implementation.

title: Recurring VPN disconnections
description: Multiple users experience repeated VPN disconnections or the same network connection failure keeps recurring.
resolution: Review network and VPN client logs, investigate recurring connection failures, and follow the approved problem-management process to identify the root cause.

title: Repeated application crashes
description: An application crashes repeatedly for multiple employees or across repeated sessions.
resolution: Collect error logs, identify affected versions and users, investigate the root cause, and document a permanent corrective action.

title: Recurring network slowness
description: Several employees experience recurring slow network performance or repeated connectivity degradation.
resolution: Review network monitoring data, inspect utilization and connectivity logs, identify the root cause, and coordinate corrective action with the network team.

title: Recurring air conditioning failure
description: The same office air conditioning fault repeatedly affects a room, floor, or workplace area.
resolution: Record the affected location, times, and symptoms. Ask the facilities team to investigate the recurring fault, review maintenance history, and document a preventive corrective action.

title: Repeated office access-card failures
description: Multiple employees or the same employee repeatedly experience physical access-card or office-entry failures.
resolution: Document affected cards, locations, and times, then ask the authorized security or facilities team to investigate the recurring access-control issue and record the root cause.

title: Recurring shared equipment failures
description: Shared office equipment repeatedly fails or multiple teams experience the same facilities equipment fault.
resolution: Record equipment identifiers, affected locations, and failure pattern. Ask the facilities or equipment support team to review maintenance records, identify the root cause, and plan corrective maintenance.
